notes.title: 1.9.10 Patch Notes + Hell is even more multilingual
notes.content:
Hey kids, what’ll it be? Your blood starting to clean itself? Let's fix that. [i]Actually[/i], we fixed some bugs. Thanks for your patience while we sorted them out. Here’s what’s mixed into this latest patch cocktail:

[list]
[*] Satan was getting stuck while walking along curved walls, but we’ve set him straight.
[*] Skoll’s bouncer went on unauthorized breaks after autosaving. We fired him.
[*] Autosaving blocked conversations with Lynda, so we got her a margarita. 
[*] Jumping into Milo’s conscience was broken, but we’ve got that little dweeb right as rain again.
[/list]

While we were at it, we added a few more subtitle languages, including LATAM Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Polish, Portuguese, and Traditional Chinese. [i]Bem-vindos ao Inferno, eu acho![/i]

Thanks for reporting issues and sharing feedback with our local support demons. If you still see something, say something on our [url=http://bit.ly/NSSsupport]support site[/url].

notes.title: What makes a good conversation? Find out at LudoNarraCon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11048438/889aa8f6147d199d676b4f3365840e6356ec8ac6.jpg[/img]
Choosing dialogue choices and having conversations is often part of the core mechanic of any narrative-driven game. How do we craft “good” conversations and what does that mean? 

Join Kahlief Adams, host and founder of the [url=https://campsite.bio/spawnonme]Spawn On Me podcast[/url], as he sits down with Adam Hines, our co-founder and lead writer. Using our catalog of [url=https://nightschoolstudio.com/games/]games[/url], they’ll discuss how writers, narrative designers, and storytellers can build interactive conversations that feel natural and engaging while pushing the boundaries of interpersonal relationships in games.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ludonarracon]Watch the panel at 4PM PST today Friday, May 6th on Steam[/url]. 

[h2]About LudoNarraCon[/h2]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ludonarracon]LudoNarraCon 2022[/url] is the fourth edition of an annual digital festival held exclusively on Steam to celebrate narrative video games and the developers that make them. Conceived and organised by indie label [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller?snr=1_614_615_ludonarracon_1601]Fellow Traveller[/url], the event is available for free to everyone to attend and free for developers to exhibit at.

👀 Behind the scenes content and live Q&As from over 40 exhibiting developers, all making story-rich games
🎮 Over 30 narrative game demos to download and play, all featured in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ludonarracon?tab=2&snr=1_614_615_ludonarracon_1601]demo section[/url]
💸 Get great discounts on more than 140 story-rich games in the LudoNarraCon sale
🎤 Watch over 16 hours of original panels and fireside chats about narrative games and game development
🖼️ Get yourself a wallpaper pack to celebrate the event, featuring tons of cool art from your favourite narrative games

notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the Afterparty[/h2]
[h3][i]You're invited[/i][/h3]

We can't believe it's been almost a full year since we unleashed Hell on Earth with Afterparty, our ultimate night-out simulator.

That seems to have gone well for Earth, so we are beyond excited to announce that we are bringing the game to Steam. Happy Spooky Season to us all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32404645/5cd6debc12713baa776e379618eb8da0d793de7d.jpg[/img]

To celebrate, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/762220/Afterparty/]Afterparty has a launch discount of 20% off[/url], or save even more by completing your Night School collection with this bundle: 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16322/

The Complete Night School Collection includes: 
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/762220/Afterparty/]Afterparty[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/388880/Oxenfree/]Oxenfree[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432530/Afterparty_OST/]Afterparty OST[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433430/Oxenfree__OST/]Oxenfree OST[/url]
[/list]
With your purchase, you'll pay for and get only the items that you don't already have in your steam library. So if you already own Oxenfree, this is the deepest discount you can get on Afterparty!

[h2]A Pub Crawl through Hell's Weirdest Districts[/h2]
[previewyoutube=aI8K7suyvZI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Over 30 drinks[/h3]
In a game where communication is one of the player’s central abilities, we wanted to let players customize how their characters would speak.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32404645/a84719b6f3fb6e60f43c87f826d5218bec70a56c.jpg[/img]

So to aid them on their extraordinary quest, Milo and Lola are going to need a little liquid courage. To that end, we’ve created over 30 drinks to get sauced on throughout the game, each providing a different type of personality boost. Think of it like equipping a weapon, but for your words… every bar has a few different drinks that, once imbibed, give extra dialogue choices. Want to talk like a raging psycho? Order a Global Extinction. Fancy some vaudevillian flair? Grab a Great Exhibitionist. Don’t even ask what a Jeffery Bomber does.

[h3]Friends in low places
[/h3]Like the best nights out, it’s about the friends you make, ditch, or piss off along the way. We’ve structured Afterparty in a way that tries to reflect those bumpy nights, so depending on who you interact with along the way, you’ll bump into a variety of folks again later in the game, many of whom may become crucial in your quest to take down Satan.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16322/

[h3]Pub games
[/h3]It wouldn’t be a night on the town if you didn’t get a chance to compete in stupid games against the weirdos you meet. Beer pong, dance-offs, and shot stacking competitions will pop up when you least expect them, adding another dimension to the story.

All of these design and story choices gave us the foundation to create our weird underworld. We hope you’ll join Milo and Lola on their quest to escape Hell, or at least throw a few back with the dead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32404645/c2de8fa1a8c50423bdc56561c2105254ab0d8212.gif[/img]

[h2]This Isn't Your Mother's Monster Mash[/h2]
Come for the hellish party tunes, stay to carry out the demonic orders played subliminally by the devil himself!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432530/Afterparty_OST/

SCNTFC's original soundtrack for Afterparty features sick beats, gregorian chants, demonic screams, and the moans of the damned. It's also in the bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16322/


[h2]Have a Hell of a Time[/h2]
We’re genuinely very excited to finally bring our follow-up to Oxenfree to you demons and ghosts, just in time for our favorite holiday. If you love the spooky season as much as we do, this bundle is for you <3 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16322/

notes.title: Go To Hell in Two Days
notes.content:
[i][b]First, the good news: Afterparty is coming to Steam on October 22![/b][/i]

Now the not-so-great news: you’ve died and are about to burn in Hell. Instead of getting cozy with the concept of being eternally flayed, you must elbow your way into Satan’s house party and convince him to grant you re-entry to Earth. But (lucky for you?) the only way he’ll consider it is if you can outdrink him.

That’s the premise of Afterparty, our next original game after [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/388880/Oxenfree/]Oxenfree[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/762220/Afterparty/
We wanted to let players inhabit their own darkly comedic adventure--like Superbad, but as a playable bender through Hell’s weirdest districts. To that end, here are the key creative pillars we focused on while making Afterparty.

[h3]Playing as two besties[/h3]
First, it was imperative to our crew that you embody not one, but two characters via Afterparty’s leads, Milo and Lola. Over the course of your night in Hell, you’ll explore the peaks and valleys of long-term friendship in ways that haven’t been seen in games before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32404645/0c800c0a34cff71ae184051fdc38391e225a6d0d.gif[/img]

Playing as a duo let our writers and designers explore not only the upside of long term friendship, but the pitfalls of knowing too much about each other. The game will pay close attention to how you shape your Milo and Lola; who you relate to more, whose plans you follow through with, and ultimately how you navigate the benefits and compromises of their friendship. By the end of the game, their relationship will be completely formed by your choices.

[h3]A new vision of Hell’s denizens[/h3]
Afterparty’s version of the afterlife draws from all religions, but is firmly rooted in reality. It was a blast developing our own set of rules, deviating from the familiar pitchforks and fire in most interpretations of Hell. Our dead people and demons have jobs, families, and argue over the good parking spot like the rest of us. But they also throw Death Day parties for serial killers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32404645/1cbc4fd7a003e12dfdafaceafb502896a41461c5.gif[/img]

[h3]An unpredictably wild night[/h3]
Whereas our last game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/388880/Oxenfree/]Oxenfree[/url], had a unifying dilemma that the whole cast was trying to overcome, we wanted to make the situations in Afterparty reflect a much larger cast with their own unique problems. Milo and Lola just happen to stumble through these moments on their own journey, and the game is structured to feel more like a binge-worthy streaming TV series filled with an unpredictable cast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32404645/3ca19ece18f90dcf01f033ad08cf2260153dd300.gif[/img]

Win over the demonic band manager who brokers deals in exchange for souls. Dance for the EDM DJ in the middle of the throbbing two-story pile of limbs. Start a fight during the reunion of a grown man with the demon that possessed his toys when he was a kid. Every bar or street corner can lead to another set of strange characters who can help Milo and Lola on their greater journey.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/762220/Afterparty/
If going out to bars and socializing (albeit with digital demons) sounds better than what you've got going on these days, then we invite you to:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32404645/ad0125567eb3bbe2274ba2446781d553a53659bf.gif[/img]

Love,
The Night School Team

notes.title: Afterparty is coming to Steam on October 22, 2020
notes.content:
Hi! How are you doing? Are you doing okay? How many wellness apps have you deleted and redownloaded in the last two weeks? Do you currently have another tab open to a video explaining how to teach World War II to a nine-year old? Are you growing your own toilet paper? Well better get on it! But before you go over to your neighbor’s house to steal his bleach, I have some actual, verifiable good news! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32404645/99c49cb114e285e2cdf978b6bb74bef7ac911334.gif[/img]

Halloween is around the corner! And in these last waning months, weeks, days and [checks watch] minutes of having a still somewhat functioning civilization, what better way to rest your weary soul than to focus on the comparatively cheerful horrors of Halloween. Costumed children skipping down the street! Raucous parties raging till dawn! Surprise office shindigs to delight young temps! None of that will be happening this year, no, but [b][i]Afterparty[/i] is coming to Steam on October 22,[/b] just in time to fuel all of your spooky cravings in lieu of being able to actually go outside and see other human beings. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/762220/Afterparty/

We’re genuinely very excited to finally bring our follow-up to Oxenfree out to you ghouls, a devilish adventure with Milo and Lola, two college friends who find themselves trapped in Hell. I know. I’m jealous, too. But to them, this is a bad thing! They want to get back to Earth, back to their lives, and, thankfully for them, there's a demonic loophole: while prowling the weird streets of Hell’s surrealist cities, if they can find and outdrink Satan himself, the Prince of Lies will return them to their placid existence. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32404645/68c0101f24a8c0ee204422637b3882958c8980e1.gif[/img]

You'll control both Milo and Lola through a phantasmagorical bar crawl positively brimming with fiendish characters you can befriend and/or torture. You'll drink from over 30 bizarre concoctions that will change the two friends' personalities, allowing you to personalize their crazy night out. You'll survive awkward bar talk, help wayward souls, play beer pong with demons, and try not to throw up even though it would probably just make you feel a whole lot better. Won’t you help Milo and Lola escape eternal torment? If you bring your laptop into bed, you don’t even have to get up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32404645/1d3beb99c037101cd59b6bcd9c09c71fd266aef0.gif[/img]

Okay. That’s it. Get some rest. Close your eyes. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/762220/Afterparty/]Add Afterparty to your Wish List.[/url] Picture a calm, blue ocean. And vote. Thanks. 


- Adam and Night School Studio

https://store.steampowered.com/app/762220/Afterparty/
